 TTP Ep. 558: Dom Mar Fan, Canon Swanson, and UFC Qatar
 Daniel Vreeland 
 November 18, 2026 
 Dom Mar Fan Interview (1:46)
 Kicking off this UFC Qatar edition of TTP is our interview with UFC lightweight, Dom Mar Fan. The Australian prospect  discusses the lessons that he learned from his lost to Kody Steele and what he’s doing to rebound from that fight. Plus, he talks about getting to fight on foreign soil for his first big card abroad. Then we break down his fight with Nikolas Motta and he gives us a prediction for how this one ends.
 TopTurtleMMA · Episode 558: Dom Mar Fan, Canon Swanson, and UFC Qatar Fights, Dogs and Parlays: UFC Qatar (12:19) 
 The UFC put on a show with a huge numbered card this past weekend, but there is no rest for the world’s number one promotion. They next head to the Middle East for UFC Qatar and the card is a banger. At the top, we have Jiri Prochazka defending his spot in the rankings against the fast-rising Navajo Stirling. Plus, Aljamain Sterling does the same when he welcomes Kevin Vallejos in a featherweight co-main event. We’ll break down those fights as well as some of our other favorite fights on the main card. Plus, as always, we’re hitting you with an underdog and a plus-money parlay that we think will make your wallet fat this weekend. For this segment, all odds via FanDuel Sportsbook .
 Canon Swanson Interview (17:07)
 Closing out this UFC Qatar edition of TTP is our interview with LFA lightweight, Canon Swanson. The Academy Minnesota’s prospect discusses the room he works in – filled with other top prospects in the sport – and how they all use that to rise to the occasion. Plus, he chats about the tutelage of Greg Nelson and John Castaneda, and discusses how they’ve helped him grow. Then he digs into his upcoming fight at LFA 247 this weekend. He breaks down the fight with Benny Orozco and let’s us know how it’ll end.
